summary: Kun Peng International Ltd. filed an 8-K announcing a 1-for-10 reverse stock split effective June 2, 2026, approved by the board and 85.4% of shareholders via written consent in January 2026. Outstanding shares decrease from 400M to ~40M, authorized shares cut from 1B to 100M, and par value increases from $0.0001 to $0.001. The stock will trade under symbol KPEAD for 20 days then revert to KPEA. This is a capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation event, so classification is Other.
